prompt:
Bold clean ink linework, flat vibrant cell-shaded colors, rounded expressive character designs, distinctive 1980s Akira Toriyama manga aesthetic. Create ONE finished landscape 1536x1024 comic panel, NOT a character sheet. Alien game world BROWN EMPTY ROCKY PLAIN and uniform overcast grey sky. NO visible sun, NO buildings, NO laboratory. 
SCENE: 왕먀오가 땅에 손을 대본다. 손바닥이 지면에 닿자 손바닥 위의 모래 알갱이들이 미세하게 진동하다 떠오른다. 손바닥에서 빛이 나는 것은 아닌데, 중력이 손바닥 주변에서 약해진다.
Visible named cast: 왕먀오. Character sheets are identity references ONLY; never copy their backgrounds. Wang Miao always wears pale blue-grey shirt and dark trousers. All lettering and exact digits will be added later: NO readable text, numbers, symbols, balloons, captions or watermark in generated artwork. Clean coherent anatomy, strong ink composition, no extra characters or alien creatures. Non-graphic disaster where described.
